name: Lycerisious Hundred Kirigasaki
original_name: リセリシアス・ハンドレッド・霧ヶ崎
source:
She is in the same grade as the protagonist but in a different class.
She is a member of Class 2-D.

As the granddaughter of the chairman, she is so well-known within the school that she and Kuyou Sarasa are often referred to as the “Twin Towers.”
She is reserved and quiet, and her kind and gentle demeanor toward everyone makes her very popular among the students.
She was born with a frail body and usually recuperates in a special room attached to the dormitory, so she is rarely seen on campus.

Perhaps because of this, she is regarded as a sheltered young lady who embodies both mystery and fragility, and seems to have a small but passionate fan base.
Her hobby is gardening, and she grows many flowers in the greenhouse on the rooftop of the Dormitory’s special wing and in her own room.
On days when she cannot go to school, gazing out the window of her room is her only pleasure.
